subject: Geografia
description_pt: Analisar características de países e grupos de países europeus, asiáticos e da Oceania em seus aspectos populacionais, urbanos, políticos e econômicos, e discutir suas desigualdades sociais e econômicas e pressões sobre seus ambientes físico-naturais.

components.description_pt: Analisar características demográficas e urbanas de países europeus, asiáticos e oceânicos
components.description_en: Analyze demographic and urban characteristics of European, Asian, and Oceanian countries

components.description_pt: Analisar dimensões políticas e econômicas de países e grupos de países na Europa, Ásia e Oceania
components.description_en: Analyze political and economic dimensions of countries and country groups in Europe, Asia, and Oceania
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between resource distribution and patterns of human economic or social development

components.description_pt: Avaliar desigualdades sociais e econômicas presentes em países europeus, asiáticos e oceânicos
components.description_en: Evaluate social and economic inequalities present in European, Asian, and Oceanian countries
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between resource distribution and patterns of human economic or social development

components.description_pt: Examinar pressões que atividades humanas exercem sobre ambientes físico-naturais na Europa, Ásia e Oceania
components.description_en: Examine pressures that human activities place on physical-natural environments in Europe, Asia, and Oceania
components.cc_component_description: Identify ways human activities in agriculture, industry, and daily life affect Earth's systems

cc_matches.description: Resource availability has guided the development of human society.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
